confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are general-knowledge estimates for Las Vegas in July 2026 and are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain because Strip resort fees and taxes vary by property. Hostel anchors rest on a thin local hostel market. FX: the 0.6955 figure came from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates overview for 2026-10-15. I did not open the rba.gov.au page myself, and a third-party figure for 2026-10-16 (0.6947) conflicts with it, so verify against the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against large US resort and convention destinations such as Orlando and Phoenix, adjusted for Las Vegas Strip pricing, mandatory resort fees and Nevada lodging taxes. Drink prices are cross-checked against the beer anchor, with cocktail at roughly 1.25x beer and wine at roughly 1.3x beer, based on typical local price relationships.
